channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Ankara urges swift implementation of deal between Syria, SDF
item.description: Türkiye has repeated its warning to the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) to swiftly and fully implement the March 10 agreement with the Syrian government, underlining that the "patience of the relevant actors is running out."

item.title: İznik chosen for final stop of year-long traveling tile art exhibition
item.description: The concluding venue for the 2025 İş Sanat Anadolu Exhibitions will be İznik, a historic town in northwestern Türkiye celebrated worldwide for its centuries-old legacy in ceramic and tile craftsmanship, thus wrapping up the year-long cultural program organized by Türkiye İş Bankası.

item.title: 12 excavation sites in Türkiye’s southeast redefine Neolithic era
item.description: The veil over the Neolithic era is gradually being lifted through a series of large-scale excavations in southern Türkiye, where archaeologists are uncovering new clues about the origins of settled human life.

item.title: Türkiye-UK trade deal expected to enter force in 2026
item.description: A free trade agreement between Türkiye and the United Kingdom is expected to enter force in the second half of 2026, the chair of the British Chamber of Commerce in Türkiye told state-run Anadolu Agency.

item.title: Israel, Greece, Greek Cyprus mulls joint rapid reaction force
item.description: Senior Israeli, Greek and Greek Cypriot officials have begun preliminary talks on the possible creation of a joint rapid reaction force, sources familiar with the discussions told Israeli media on Dec. 18.

item.title: Actress among eight detained in high-profile Istanbul drug probe
item.description: Turkish authorities have carried out a third wave of arrests in a widening drug investigation targeting figures from the entertainment and media sectors, detaining eight suspects including a high-profile actress, prosecutors said on Dec. 19.

item.title: Türkiye, US, Qatar, Egypt to hold Gaza talks in Miami
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on Friday will attend a meeting focusing on Gaza in Miami, U.S., the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.

item.title: Türkiye's Aselsan secures $410 mln defense deal with Poland
item.description: One of Türkiye’s leading defense industry companies, Aselsan, has signed a $410 million contract for the direct sale of electronic warfare systems to Poland, according to Turkish media reports.

item.title: 'Ball in court' of West and Kiev on Ukraine talks, says Putin
item.description: Vladimir Putin on Friday hailed his troops' progress in Ukraine during an annual press conference in Moscow — a staple of his 25-year rule — with the Russian president emboldened by battlefield gains in Ukraine during a U.S. diplomatic push to end the almost four-year war.

item.title: Parliament panel moves toward final report on anti-terror bid
item.description: A parliamentary commission overseeing the government’s “terror-free Türkiye” initiative is set to consolidate separate party reports into a single framework for new legislation.
